topic.title: Content Generation
topic.shortdesc: Automatic generation of cover pages, title pages, copyright pages, navigation, indexes, glossaries, and lists.

body.p: Beyond transforming your DITA topics into XHTML, the content generationdita2epub plugin generates several structural pages automatically. These pages are standard components of professionally published books, and producing them by hand would be tedious and error-prone.
The plugin generates two categories of content:

ul.li: Front matter pages — cover, title page, copyright page, and table of contents navigation
Back matter pages — back-of-book index, consolidated glossary, list of figures, and list of tables

body.p: Most generated pages operate in auto mode by default: they are produced only when the necessary source content exists in the bookmap. You can force generation on or off with explicit yes or no parameter values.
